title: kubecon-eu-2026-travel-admin-scratchpad
content:
Quick admin scratchpad for KubeCon EU 2026 (Barcelona) — notes + ToDos + vendor contacts.

Summary: attending 2026-05-10 to 2026-05-14. Flights booked (LHR-BCN). Need to finalize local transport, hotel incidentals, and expense receipts. Keep this tidy for finance reimbursement.

Itinerary (tentative)
- 2026-05-10: Flight BA247, dep LHR 08:35, arr BCN 11:55. Taxi to hotel. Check-in.
- 2026-05-11: Booth setup (09:00), sponsor reception (19:00)
- 2026-05-12: Talks + meetings (09:00-17:00)
- 2026-05-13: Demos + partner dinners (evening)
- 2026-05-14: Fly back BA260 dep BCN 16:30 arr LHR 18:45

Packing / admin checklist
- Passport/ID + printed boarding pass (or mobile).
- Company credit card + personal card.
- Laptop + chargers + USB-C hub.
- Adaptors (EU plug).
- Business cards / handouts for booth.
- Backup phone charger / battery pack.
- COVID/health kit (if needed).

Pre-conference tasks
- Confirm booth shipment arrival with logistics vendor (see below) — SLA 48h.
- Upload expense policy + pre-approval form to Concur (CONCUR-REDWOOD).
- Add travel dates to calendar + set OOO where needed.
- Share meeting slots with partners (use Calendly link).

Expense reminders (for finance)
- Save all receipts (meals, taxis, taxis to/from airport, shuttle, parking). Take photos immediately.
- Use company card for hotel and flights when possible; tag personal misc.
- Per diem: check policy for Barcelona (meal cap EUR 60/day).
- Submit expenses within 14 days after travel. Attach boarding passes and hotel folio.
- Expense codes: TRVL-KC2026, MARK-SUPPORT

Vendors / Contacts
- Logistics (booth shipping / setup): EuroEvent Logistics — contact Marta Ruiz, +34 612 345 678, m.ruiz@euroevent.es. Lead: Jordan coordinating shipment.
- AV & Cables: BCN AV Services — contact: Tomas Lopez, +34 600 987 123, tomas@bcnav.es. Request: 2x HDMI extender, charging strip, on-call tech for setup AM 05/11.
- Hotel: Hotel Catalonia Sants — booking ref: RWD-45821. Front desk +34 93 123 4567. Ask for early check-in if booth arrives early.
- Taxi / Local transport: Cabify / Bolt recommended. Keep receipts; get driver name if expensive.
- Catering for booth: TapasExpress — contact: lucia@tapasexpress.es. Small bites for 2 days, dietary: vegetarian + gluten-free options.

People to notify / meeting prep
- Send final booth roster to People Ops (Emily Tran) by 2026-04-20.
- Meeting prep doc: link to Deck (DECK-KC-2026) + demo checklist.

Notes to self / loose thoughts
- Bring extra dongles — last-minute fixes are messy.
- Reconfirm logistics 72h before shipment ETA.
- If delay > 4h, escalate to Marta and log in Slack #events-logistics.
- Keep physical petty cash EUR 100 for last-minute vendor tips.

Open questions / follow-ups
- Confirm whether hotel will provide invoice with company name for reimbursement (ask when checking out).
- Is there a company badge pickup pre-window? If so, who collects them?
- Final list of attendees to be finalized by 2026-04-15.

Quick links
- Concur expense form: CONCUR-REDWOOD (submit after travel)
- Internal event page: confluence.redwood/kubecon-eu-2026

End of scratchpad. Update as I get confirmations.

-- Maya
